title: rubus pallidus subsp. foliolatus
intro: Rubus pallidus subsp. foliolatus, commonly known as the 'Fairy Raspberry', is a subspecies of the Rubus pallidus plant, a type of bramble native to the Mediterranean region. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, particularly in treating digestive issues, and its leaves are rich in antioxidants that may help to protect against oxidative stress and inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Rubus pallidus subsp. foliolatus include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, which can aid in wound healing, reducing fever, and soothing digestive disorders. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and tannins, which contribute to its potential health benefits and medicinal applications.
